summary: Retain browser runtime for reloading the active document.

target.notes: Invoke the HTML reload-navigation algorithm for the current navigable/document.

caveats: Do not map to re-reading a URL with HttpClient; document identity/lifecycle, history and cache semantics differ.

tests.name: reload is navigation
tests.expected_behavior: requests reload of the active document

tests.name: reload does not append arbitrary application state
tests.expected_behavior: uses the current navigation/session-history context rather than constructing a new unrelated request
